obs: "It would be at least unusual to ascribe jurisdictional significance to a condition subject to these sorts of exceptions."

"We have repeatedly stated that the enactment of time-limitation periods such as that in 2244(d), without further elaboration, produces defenses that are nonjurisdictional and thus subject to waiver and forfeiture"
"But a prescription does not become jurisdictional whenever it promotes important congressional objectives."
MOAC Mall Holdings LLC v. Transform Holdco LLC
"since it would have been at least unusual to ascribe jurisdictional significance to a condition subject to these sorts of exceptions"
